btts_and_clean_sheet#contract_unsampled_.description: 185 of 203 BTTS series have rules text with one wording per window; 18 are TITLE_ONLY. No BTTS text states settlement for postponement, cancellation or a match abandoned after both sides have scored, and the half texts do not say whether stoppage time belongs to the half or whether a 2nd Half in a knockout game includes extra time.
btts_and_clean_sheet#contract_unsampled_.what_would_resolve: Kalshi's general soccer rulebook clause for abandonment/postponement and the 2H/extra-time definition, read for BTTS half series.

btts_and_clean_sheet#cross_tier_lambda_f.description: In Copa del Rey, Israeli Cup and Copa do Brasil early rounds the weaker side lambda (the binding quantity for BTTS) is poorly identified; the cross-tier link soc.cross_tier_strength_link and soc.favourite_rotation_in_mismatch are defined in the handicap_and_exact_score record, not in the catalog yet.
btts_and_clean_sheet#cross_tier_lambda_f.what_would_resolve: Share the handicap record cross-tier inputs after catalog merge and attach them here; test min-lambda calibration on cross-tier cup games.

btts_and_clean_sheet#event_source_red_ca.description: Red-card timing and score-before are not exposed by Understat shot pages as far as is known; red_card_flag requires a second provider (API-Football/Opta) and coverage of non-top-6 leagues has not been checked.
btts_and_clean_sheet#event_source_red_ca.what_would_resolve: Pull one sample match per league from API-Football and from Understat and compare event fields.

btts_and_clean_sheet#fbref_opta_source.description: The availability of PSxG and big-chance fields on free sites after the reported 2026 loss of Opta advanced data on FBref has not been checked, and Understat only covers a few leagues; many BTTS series (Venezuela, K League, Israel) have no free xG.
btts_and_clean_sheet#fbref_opta_source.what_would_resolve: Check each league's free source for xG/PSxG; fall back to goals-based ratings with a documented wider shrinkage where none exists.

btts_and_clean_sheet#fts_excess_identifi.description: Whether excess failed-to-score beyond Poisson is stable across seasons or just noise at 38 matches per team is not established; the shrinkage constant and window are a guess.
btts_and_clean_sheet#fts_excess_identifi.what_would_resolve: Estimate year-over-year persistence of excess_FTS on 8+ seasons of top-5 league data and set shrinkage by empirical Bayes.

btts_and_clean_sheet#own_goal_propensity.description: Own goals supply roughly 3-5% of goals and count for the beneficiary, but no input measures own-goal propensity of a defence or the crossing volume that creates it, and no free source tags own goals consistently outside the top leagues.
btts_and_clean_sheet#own_goal_propensity.what_would_resolve: Define a shrunk own-goals-for-against rate from Understat own-goal flags and test whether it adds anything over ratings.

btts_and_clean_sheet#rotation_stakes_eff.description: Rotation, stakes and second-leg aggregate inputs are attached to s4 but no free point-in-time rotation ground truth exists and the size of their effect on P(both score) in domestic cups is not established from available data.
btts_and_clean_sheet#rotation_stakes_eff.what_would_resolve: Backtest BTTS residuals against rotation_index and aggregate-state buckets on three seasons of cup and league games.

competition_head_to_head#gap_coaching_sc.description: Mid-season managerial change, tactical shift and a pending sacking or appointment change points-per-game and no listed input captures them; effect size and persistence are debated (this entry merges the earlier mid_season_manager_effect item).
competition_head_to_head#gap_coaching_sc.what_would_resolve: Event study of league points-per-game before and after managerial changes over 10 seasons with matched controls, then define a manager-change input.

competition_head_to_head#h2h_format_vari.description: For leagues with split seasons, hexagonals, playoffs or conferences a finish-ahead contract could compare aggregate table, stage table or playoff outcome; no live H2H series outside the EPL is known and the compared metric is not visible in any rules text.
competition_head_to_head#h2h_format_vari.what_would_resolve: Obtain rules text for any non-EPL finish-ahead series and record the compared table per league.

competition_head_to_head#h2h_series_rule.description: All seven series now have rules text; KXEPLH2H does not say what happens if a meeting is postponed past the season end, and neither World Cup comparison nor KXPPPKSO has a postponement, abandonment or no-show clause.
competition_head_to_head#h2h_series_rule.what_would_resolve: Kalshi rulebook clauses for unplayed league meetings and for exhibition no-shows.

competition_head_to_head#h2h_three_mecha.description: The key now holds four unrelated mechanisms (league table order, two-meeting result combinations, World Cup stage/player comparisons, an influencer penalty duel); stages s7-s9 rely on new inputs with little or no historical calibration, especially KXPPPKSO.
competition_head_to_head#h2h_three_mecha.what_would_resolve: Re-file World Cup comparisons and the PrizePicks duel into dedicated keys and calibrate the equality model on past tournaments.

competition_head_to_head#pk_duel_no_hist.description: No public kick-by-kick history exists for the KXPPPKSO contestants on the stated 10x6 ft net, so soc.influencer_pk_duel_skill rests on priors and manual coding of social-media clips of unknown representativeness.
competition_head_to_head#pk_duel_no_hist.what_would_resolve: Own capture of any prior duels of the contestants, or several PrizePicks events to estimate pooled amateur conversion.

competition_winner_and_top_n#epl_top4_qu.description: KXEPLTOP4 says it is determined by whether the club qualifies (even if it does not compete), which reads as Champions League qualification; whether an extra European Performance Spot or a cup-winner route that sends fifth place into the Champions League resolves YES for that club is not stated.
competition_winner_and_top_n#epl_top4_qu.what_would_resolve: Kalshi clarification or a settled KXEPLTOP4 season where fifth place qualified.

competition_winner_and_top_n#extra_time_.description: The round win probability w_r = P(win in 90) + P(draw) x 0.5 with a 0.52-0.55 stronger-side tilt for extra time and penalties is an unsourced placeholder in soc.bracket_path_difficulty; the true tilt and shootout skill effect are not estimated.
competition_winner_and_top_n#extra_time_.what_would_resolve: Estimate the extra-time and shootout win rate of the stronger side from historical cup knockouts and replace the placeholder.

competition_winner_and_top_n#format_conv.description: Historical P(champion | seed) for playoff formats rests on small samples (about 10 seasons per league and formats change), so the conversion table has wide error bars and format-change breaks.
competition_winner_and_top_n#format_conv.what_would_resolve: Pool formats by structure type (single-leg vs two-leg, seeded vs not) with hierarchical shrinkage and document breaks.

competition_winner_and_top_n#gap_coachin.description: Manager changes and in-season tactical evolution shift a contender's strength, and the true effect size of a sacking or appointment is not estimated in any input here; the existing catalog only flags it inside soc.transfers.
competition_winner_and_top_n#gap_coachin.what_would_resolve: Event-study estimating the change in points-per-game after manager changes with matched controls across top leagues.

competition_winner_and_top_n#ledger_mixe.description: The key now holds titles, top-N, group winners, trophy counts and trebles, team-set unions, exact orders and three single-match residuals; the margin series moved to team_points_and_margin and the GAME/prop series left. KXWCFINALMATCHUP and KXAFCCL2GAME remain TITLE_ONLY residuals.
competition_winner_and_top_n#ledger_mixe.what_would_resolve: Rules text for KXWCFINALMATCHUP, KXWCWINMARGIN, KXAFCCL2GAME and the UCL/UEL round-of-16 series, then re-file the residuals.

competition_winner_and_top_n#rating_sour.description: The sampled rules-text series are dominated by Paraguay, Uruguay, Peru, Venezuela, Ecuador, Chile, Argentina, Libertadores and Sudamericana outrights, and by national-team tournaments; ClubElo is European-centred and Understat covers six European leagues, so soc.ratings, soc.ratings_uncertainty and soc.preseason_prior are not verifiably computable from free sources for these competitions.
competition_winner_and_top_n#rating_sour.what_would_resolve: Check ClubElo and eloratings.net coverage per league and fall back to an own results-based Dixon-Coles fit; record which leagues have xG-based ratings at all.

competition_winner_and_top_n#retroactive.description: Whether a title stripped after settlement (the Manchester City-type cases) changes settlement of a league-winner contract is not stated in the sampled outright text and cannot be inferred.
competition_winner_and_top_n#retroactive.what_would_resolve: Obtain Kalshi's full rulebook language on post-resolution sanctions for outright markets.

competition_winner_and_top_n#third_place.description: KXWC3RDPLACE says only 'wins the third-place match'; whether extra time and penalties count toward the win, and the postponement rule, are not stated, unlike KXINTERCUPADVANCE which says 'including extra time and penalties'.
competition_winner_and_top_n#third_place.what_would_resolve: Full rules text of KXWC3RDPLACE or its settlement history.

competition_winner_and_top_n#uefa_format.description: The 36-team UEFA league phase has only a few completed seasons, so P(advance | rank) and the shootout/tie-break base rates cannot be fitted from history; the two new UEFA inputs rely on simulation from team strengths and are uncalibrated against realised format outcomes.
competition_winner_and_top_n#uefa_format.what_would_resolve: Backtest simulated rank distributions against the realised 2024-25 onward league phases once the rules texts of the UEFA series are read.

first_half_and_period#abandonment_in_hal.description: Sampled half-market rules describe cancellation or rescheduling beyond 48 hours but not an abandonment mid-half (e.g. at 30 minutes), so settlement for a partial first half is unknown.
first_half_and_period#abandonment_in_hal.what_would_resolve: Request the full Kalshi rulebook language for suspended matches in half-specific markets.

first_half_and_period#added_time_vintage.description: Free sources for announced and actual stoppage minutes per half were not verified; football-data.co.uk does not carry it and scraping match reports is inconsistent across leagues.
first_half_and_period#added_time_vintage.what_would_resolve: Verify one provider (Opta, FBref match logs) exposes per-half added minutes and test the coverage for 10 leagues.

first_half_and_period#cup_second_half_ex.description: The 2nd Half winner/Tie texts state 45 minutes plus stoppage (KXUEFASC2H), but the 2H total and spread texts only say goals 'scored during the 2nd Half', and no text mentions extra time; whether extra-time goals could count in a 2H total/spread of a knockout game is not stated.
first_half_and_period#cup_second_half_ex.what_would_resolve: Kalshi rulebook definition of '2nd Half' for total/spread markets in knockout games, or a settled cup 2H total that went to extra time.

first_half_and_period#gap_environment.description: Heat, humidity, altitude and pitch reduce second-half intensity relative to the first; the size of the effect on the 1H/2H goal split by league and month is not established and the catalog weather input is not tied to halves.
first_half_and_period#gap_environment.what_would_resolve: Regress 2H share of goals on kickoff temperature/humidity and altitude using multi-season data with kickoff hour as control.

first_half_and_period#half_dependence_ta.description: Whether half-level Dixon-Coles rho and a simple draw-inflation parameter capture the 1H exact-score ladder (scores above 2-1) is untested; tail cells are rare and sparse in per-league data.
first_half_and_period#half_dependence_ta.what_would_resolve: Backtest log loss on half exact scores with pooled-league parameters and compare to full-time-only rho.

first_half_and_period#half_score_ladder_.description: First-half correct-score texts (KXMLS1HSCORE, KXWC1HSCORE and siblings) carry no secondary clause: postponement handling and whether an 'any other score' rung completes the partition are not stated, unlike the half winner/total/spread texts.
first_half_and_period#half_score_ladder_.what_would_resolve: Full market list of one KX*1HSCORE event and its complete rules text.

first_half_and_period#half_xg_coverage_n.description: Understat shot-level xG with minute covers six European leagues (plus RPL); the live half series span Liga Portugal, Liga MX, MLS, USL, Eredivisie, Brasileiro, CONMEBOL and cups, where only HT/FT scores (and unverified paid event feeds) exist, so soc.half_specific_xg_ratings and soc.second_half_state_multiplier cannot be computed from free data there.
first_half_and_period#half_xg_coverage_n.what_would_resolve: Verify per-league goal-minute availability on API-Football/Wyscout samples and fall back to HT/FT-based ratings (soc.period_split) where minutes are missing.

first_to_score_event#archetype_mismatch.description: After the reconciliation the key holds two contract families: 32 First Team to Score series (target verified from rules text) and 37 Method of Victory/Finish series (23 MOV, 14 MOF) whose settlement is unseen; the MOV/MOF stages (s2-s4, s7) are untested against any contract text.
first_to_score_event#archetype_mismatch.what_would_resolve: Rules text for at least one knockout MOF and one league MOV series, or splitting the Method series into their own key.

first_to_score_event#ftts_no_goal_market.description: FTTS texts now show a listed 'No Goal' market (KXWCFTTS, KXGERSCFTTS, KXENGCSFTTS), so the outcome set sums to one; still unstated in all 23 FTTS texts is how a postponed match or one abandoned after the first goal settles.
first_to_score_event#ftts_no_goal_market.what_would_resolve: Kalshi rulebook clause on postponed/abandoned FTTS events, or a settled abandoned-match example.

first_to_score_event#gap_settlement_cont.description: The settlement text for Method of Victory/Finish contracts is not in the sample at all, and whether league fixtures, two-leg aggregates or penalty shootouts map to the outcomes is unknown; first-scorer settlement is now verified from 23 FTTS texts in this key, so the gap is the Method series only.
first_to_score_event#gap_settlement_cont.what_would_resolve: Fetch rules_primary/rules_secondary for one MOV and one MOF series and re-map the bucket.

first_to_score_event#inputs_unaudited_in.description: soc.second_leg_aggregate_state, soc.extra_time_shootout_model and soc.penalty_shootout_skill are catalog inputs used in stages s2-s4 but are not in this archetype existing-input list, so they carry no archetype-level audit; the extra-time goal rate and first-kicker numbers are unsourced.
first_to_score_event#inputs_unaudited_in.what_would_resolve: Audit the three inputs for this archetype on merge and estimate ET goal rate and first-kicker edge from RSSSF/Wikipedia knockout records.

first_to_score_event#mov_league_outcome_.description: The six league KX*MOV series cannot involve extra time or penalties, so their outcome set is unknown (margin buckets, win/draw, something else); s2-s4 and the shootout inputs do not apply to them and s7 is a conditional placeholder.
first_to_score_event#mov_league_outcome_.what_would_resolve: Fetch rules_primary/secondary for KXLALIGAMOV and KXSERIEAMOV and replace s7 with the actual outcome partition.

first_to_score_event#mov_mof_semantics.description: No rules text exists for any of the 37 live Method series (Method of Victory/Finish): outcome labels, whether league matches are included, whether extra-time-win and penalty-win are separate strikes, and treatment of aggregate ties are unknown.
first_to_score_event#mov_mof_semantics.what_would_resolve: Fetch rules_primary/secondary for KXCOPADELREYMOV, KXLALIGAMOV and KXFACUPMOF and confirm outcome sets (the related KXUCLMOV text, filed under relegation_qualification_advancement, uses Regular Time / Extra Time / Penalty Shootout outcomes).

first_to_score_event#rating_source_cover.description: The MOV/MOF series include AFC Champions League, Copa del Rey amateur-round fixtures, US Open Cup and Club World Cup, where ClubElo and Understat (European-centred) may not rate the clubs; strength inputs are unverified for these.
first_to_score_event#rating_source_cover.what_would_resolve: Check ClubElo coverage for AFC, CONCACAF and lower-division clubs and use an own results-based rating where missing.

first_to_score_event#shootout_sample_siz.description: Penalty shootout edges (first-kicker advantage, keeper skill) are estimated from small samples (fewer than 300 professional shootouts per competition family) and persistence of taker/keeper skill is weak.
first_to_score_event#shootout_sample_siz.what_would_resolve: Pool across competitions with hierarchical shrinkage and test for out-of-sample predictive lift.

handicap_and_exact_score#cross_tier_sour.description: soc.cross_tier_strength_link relies on ClubElo and football-data.co.uk cup results; neither is known to rate tier-6+ clubs (Coupe de France regional sides, Copa del Rey amateur clubs) or women's league clubs such as those in KXFRAPLWSPREAD, so the primary cross-tier input is undefined for part of the sample.
handicap_and_exact_score#cross_tier_sour.what_would_resolve: Check ClubElo/football-data coverage for those tiers and women's leagues; otherwise fall back to a tier-prior with wide uncertainty.

handicap_and_exact_score#cup_bridge_iden.description: Cross-tier ratings rest on few inter-division matches per season and are poorly identified for the bottom tiers (amateur sides in Copa del Rey) with unobserved strength differences of unknown size.
handicap_and_exact_score#cup_bridge_iden.what_would_resolve: Estimate bridge sd from held-out cup ties; if too wide, widen margin distribution explicitly.

handicap_and_exact_score#exact_score_et_.description: KXWCSCOREET counts the entire game including extra time; still unstated is whether it is listed for group-stage games (where it equals the regulation score), and no correct-score text shows draw rungs or an 'any other score' rung, so the extra-time convolution cannot be checked against a complete partition.
handicap_and_exact_score#exact_score_et_.what_would_resolve: Full market list of one KXWCSCOREET knockout event and one group-stage event, with all rungs.

handicap_and_exact_score#exact_score_run.description: Sampled correct-score texts show only 'X wins a-b' rungs; whether draw rungs and an 'other score' rung exist, and whether the ladder partitions all outcomes, is not visible.
handicap_and_exact_score#exact_score_run.what_would_resolve: Pull the full market list for one KXUEFANLSCORE event and confirm every rung.

handicap_and_exact_score#gap_situational.description: Whether the favourite prioritises the match (cup rounds between league fixtures, European weeks) is only partially encoded in rotation and stakes inputs and has not been linked to margin tails; effect of priority on exact-score ladder is unmeasured.
handicap_and_exact_score#gap_situational.what_would_resolve: Backtest margin distribution against rotation probability using cup-tie data over 5+ seasons.

handicap_and_exact_score#rotation_ground.description: Pre-lineup rotation signals (press conferences, training reports) are not archived with historical timestamps in any free source, so the rotation predictor cannot be backtested point-in-time.
handicap_and_exact_score#rotation_ground.what_would_resolve: Start own capture of team news now and accumulate vintages; consider paid lineup-prediction feeds.

match_result_3way#altitude_effect_size.description: The size and decay of acclimatisation for visiting teams has mixed evidence and shows large heterogeneity by team fitness; no source gives day-by-day exposure records.
match_result_3way#altitude_effect_size.what_would_resolve: Fit gap and exposure models on CONMEBOL qualifier and Libertadores data and test out-of-sample.

match_result_3way#bucket_mixed_contracts.description: All 155 live series are GAME series (the two basketball series are now out of scope); 143 have rules text and 12 are TITLE_ONLY. KXBALLERLEAGUEGAME (small-sided) has no window or postponement clause, and the all-star/college series rely on a format profile with little history.
match_result_3way#bucket_mixed_contracts.what_would_resolve: Baller League rulebook and Kalshi's settlement of a Baller League game decided after a level regulation; rules for the 12 TITLE_ONLY series.

match_result_3way#league_source_coverage.description: The 155 GAME series span dozens of competitions (Bolivia, Paraguay, Uruguay, Argentina, Liga Expansion, Serie C, Qatar, UAE, club friendlies); football-data.co.uk, Understat and ClubElo do not verifiably cover most of them, so xG ratings, referee columns and results history are unverified for those leagues.
match_result_3way#league_source_coverage.what_would_resolve: Tabulate per-league availability of results, xG and referee data from the listed sources and mark leagues needing own results-based ratings.

match_result_3way#rotation_timing.description: Historical predicted-lineup snapshots (the expectation the market had) are not archived publicly, so lineup surprise cannot be reconstructed for backtests beyond own capture.
match_result_3way#rotation_timing.what_would_resolve: Begin timestamped capture of predicted/confirmed lineups across the leagues in the ledger.

match_result_3way#two_way_winner_unverif.description: The catalog lists a two-way winner family but none of the 143 sampled soccer GAME texts is a no-draw winner contract (all are 90-minute three-way partitions, Baller League aside); the 2-way target is unverified for soccer.
match_result_3way#two_way_winner_unverif.what_would_resolve: Re-map the ledger and verify whether any live 2-way soccer winner series exists.

player_award#announcement_correction.description: The ledger types KXBALLONDORAWARD as rules_review_correction; whether a corrected or amended official announcement changes settlement is not shown in the sampled rules and affects timing and finality risk.
player_award#announcement_correction.what_would_resolve: Read the full rules and lifecycle history of KXBALLONDORAWARD for correction language.

player_award#award_sample_size_regimes.description: Women's Ballon d'Or has about 7 usable ceremonies since 2018 (none in 2020), the points scale and voter panel have changed, and a season-based window was adopted recently, so a ridge conditional logit with tournament-year interactions is under-identified.
player_award#award_sample_size_regimes.what_would_resolve: Pool men's and women's results with a shared coefficient structure, document regime changes, and quantify prediction intervals by leave-one-year-out.

player_award#ballot_scale_panel_unverifi.description: The ballot points scale, voter count and panel composition used in the panel simulation (and the men's versus women's difference) are not in the market text and are not backed by a cited source.
player_award#ballot_scale_panel_unverifi.what_would_resolve: Obtain the awarding body's published voting regulations for the women's award and record scale and panel size.

player_award#leak_reliability.description: The frequency and reliability of pre-ceremony leaks for this specific award is a small-sample estimate (a few cases) and false leaks cannot be verified in advance.
player_award#leak_reliability.what_would_resolve: Log all leak claims across 3-5 ceremonies to estimate reliability by source tier.

player_award#narrative_signal_validity.description: Whether media mention volume or pageviews predict award ranks beyond goals and trophies is untested on the few available award years, so the narrative input has data defined but no demonstrated signal.
player_award#narrative_signal_validity.what_would_resolve: Backtest media-attention features against historical ranks with leave-one-year-out validation.

player_award#pricing_horizon_unknown.description: The men's 2027 Ballon d'Or market (KXBALLONDOR) is listed in November 2026, so award markets do trade before the eligibility window closes; the listing and closing dates of the PFA and EPL award series are still not visible (World Cup awards trade during the tournament) and the decay of availability inputs toward the ceremony is unmeasured.
player_award#pricing_horizon_unknown.what_would_resolve: Read first-trade timestamps and lifecycle of the sibling award series and mark inputs as active-before-close or inert-after-close accordingly.

player_award#voter_composition_unknown.description: The panel composition (nationality, count, reporting of individual ballots) is published only after the ceremony and the home-nation bias estimate rests on a handful of years of published ballots.
player_award#voter_composition_unknown.what_would_resolve: Collect published voter lists and individual ballots across prior ceremonies to estimate bias.

player_award#wc_award_selector_unverifie.description: The KXWCAWARD text says the Ball goes to the player 'recognized by FIFA'; the selection body and process (technical study group, media or fan vote shares) for 2026 is not stated and not verified, so the selection model's structure is an assumption.
player_award#wc_award_selector_unverifie.what_would_resolve: FIFA's published 2026 award regulations naming the selection panel and procedure.

player_award#womens_data_coverage.description: Women's football has far thinner xG and event data on free sites (Understat covers no women's leagues, FBref women's coverage was Opta-based and has been reported curtailed), so season-production inputs for the women's award are not verifiably available.
player_award#womens_data_coverage.what_would_resolve: Check StatsBomb open data and licensed coverage for UWCL/WSL players before building the production feature.

player_season_leader_and_awards#bucket_h.description: The key holds league goal and assist leaders, an EPL season-stat ladder and eleven World Cup tally series (anytime goal, counts, leader, country top scorer, trio sum, streak, record, career, record timing); all 20 have rules text, but they mix season-long and three-to-eight-match exposures with different tie rules (dead heat, $1/N, FIFA tiebreak).
player_season_leader_and_awards#bucket_h.what_would_resolve: Splitting World Cup tally series into a tournament-tally key with the exposure input, once the receiving key is approved.

player_season_leader_and_awards#ftts_no_.description: Carried pointer: the FTTS series left this key for first_to_score_event, where the recovered texts now show a listed 'No Goal' outcome; within this key the analogous open point is the country top-scorer 'No Goalscorer' leg of KXWCTEAMLEADGOAL, whose interaction with the $1/N dead heat when every scorer has one goal is not spelled out.
player_season_leader_and_awards#ftts_no_.what_would_resolve: Full KXWCTEAMLEADGOAL rules text beyond the sampled cut, showing the dead-heat and no-goalscorer clauses together.

player_season_leader_and_awards#gap_coac.description: Manager changes alter a striker's role and service, and a tactical shift (system change, new playmaker) can change goals per 90 by 20-30% in the middle of a season; no input quantifies this and press-conference news does not capture it.
player_season_leader_and_awards#gap_coac.what_would_resolve: Event-study of striker goals/90 before and after managerial changes and new signings across leagues with matched controls.

player_season_leader_and_awards#leader_t.description: Dead-heat, scope and transfer rules are now read for all leader series; still unknown are the counting scope of KXEPLSEASONSTAT ('across all games during the 2026-27 EPL season'), and whether disallowed or retroactively reassigned goals (dubious-goals panels) change official league totals before settlement.
player_season_leader_and_awards#leader_t.what_would_resolve: Kalshi clarification of KXEPLSEASONSTAT scope and the snapshot date of official statistics used for settlement.

player_season_leader_and_awards#penalty_.description: Predicting penalty duty after transfers or injuries (who takes penalties when the regular taker is absent) relies on irregular news and small samples per club.
player_season_leader_and_awards#penalty_.what_would_resolve: Build taker succession lists from historical absences and test the accuracy on 3 seasons.

player_season_leader_and_awards#wc_recor.description: KXWCMBAPPEGOALLEADER counts becoming sole leader 'for any amount of time' in a named round, and KXWCGOALSTREAK carries the 2022 streak state; how a goal later reassigned as an own goal, or a match abandoned mid-way, affects the record round or streak is not stated.
player_season_leader_and_awards#wc_recor.what_would_resolve: Full rules text beyond the sampled cut and Kalshi's handling of FIFA goal reassignments.

relegation_qualification_advancement#awa.description: Away-goals treatment in national cups and in UEFA/CONMEBOL ties changed over the sample period and no source verified which rule applied to each historical tie.
relegation_qualification_advancement#awa.what_would_resolve: Record per-competition per-season away-goals rules from the regulations before building the tie tree history.

relegation_qualification_advancement#gap.description: Mid-season managerial changes ('new manager bounce') are a recognised driver of relegation-zone teams, yet no input quantifies their effect size or timing, and the catalog only holds a manager-change flag under transfers.
relegation_qualification_advancement#gap.what_would_resolve: Event study of points per game after in-season manager changes for bottom-six teams across top leagues with matched controls.

relegation_qualification_advancement#man.description: The new-manager effect on relegation-zone teams is contested in the literature (regression to the mean confounds it) and no input measures it.
relegation_qualification_advancement#man.what_would_resolve: Event study with matched controls using 10 seasons of managerial changes.

relegation_qualification_advancement#mix.description: The key mixes table placement (last place, relegation, promotion), single- and two-leg ties, qualification/stage-reach and World Cup set aggregates; 85 of 176 series are TITLE_ONLY, so legs, extra-time/penalty and tiebreak treatment is unknown for many tie series, and only KXMLSADVANCE and KXINTERCUPADVANCE state 'including extra time and penalties'.
relegation_qualification_advancement#mix.what_would_resolve: Pull rules_secondary for one series per family and re-key the archetype by contract structure.

relegation_qualification_advancement#pla.description: EFL promotion via play-offs is a short knockout tournament after the regular season, and no input models the play-off stage or the semi-final tie structure.
relegation_qualification_advancement#pla.what_would_resolve: Add a play-off bracket model fitted to historical play-off results (about 20 seasons of EFL data).

relegation_qualification_advancement#rat.description: A large share of the 176 series are national-team (World Cup, Euro and Nations League qualification, AFCON) or non-European league and cup series; club-only sources (ClubElo, football-data.co.uk, Transfermarkt) do not verifiably rate these, so the main strength input is not defined for them from the original sources alone.
relegation_qualification_advancement#rat.what_would_resolve: Check eloratings.net and FIFA coverage for the national-team series and build own results-based ratings for non-European leagues.

relegation_qualification_advancement#sta.description: KXWCFURTHESTADVANCING and KXWCSTAGEOFELIM define stage lists, dead heats and withdrawals, but KXWCHOSTSTAGE and KXWCSTAGE texts do not show whether 'lose the final' vs 'win the final' are separate stages for the set maximum or how third-place-match results are treated.
relegation_qualification_advancement#sta.what_would_resolve: Full rules text of KXWCHOSTSTAGE and the outcome list of KXWCSTAGE.

relegation_qualification_advancement#top.description: Rank-vs-qualification question after the reconciliation: the top-N series moved to competition_winner_and_top_n (where KXEPLTOP4 turns out to be a qualification event); in this key KXUCLQUAL, KXUCLRO16 and KXWCROUND settle on qualifying, so the slot allocation and the exact qualification route (league position vs play-off vs coefficient slot) define them, and the tie rule at a qualification cut is not stated.
relegation_qualification_advancement#top.what_would_resolve: UEFA slot-allocation table for the season and Kalshi confirmation that every qualification route counts for KXUCLQUAL.

relegation_qualification_advancement#unm.description: Still without rules text: KXWCHOSTSTAGE (host-nation furthest stage, now handled by stage s7) and the league 'To Advance' series KXEPLADVANCE, KXSERIEAADVANCE, KXLIGUE1ADVANCE, whose compared object is unknown; the top-N series moved to competition_winner_and_top_n and KXWCGROUPWINELIM to unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props.
relegation_qualification_advancement#unm.what_would_resolve: Rules text for KXWCHOSTSTAGE and the league 'To Advance' series.

soccer_special_and_host#destination_norm.description: Point-in-time PSR/FFP headroom and player stated preferences are not archived with timestamps in free sources, so destination feasibility can be backtested only on lagged accounts and the normalisation across candidates and the no-change outcome cannot be calibrated from history.
soccer_special_and_host#destination_norm.what_would_resolve: Capture club and rumour data with own timestamps and use realised destinations of comparable moves for calibration.

soccer_special_and_host#heterogeneous_ev.description: The bucket spans transfers, next-club sets, manager exits and appointments, retirements, office-holder exits, host and format announcements, sanctions, participation and a skills challenge; 11 of 47 series have no rules text, and the term 'Source Agencies' for announcements is undefined in the sample.
soccer_special_and_host#heterogeneous_ev.what_would_resolve: Fetch rules for next-manager, retirement and FIFA series; split into player_move, manager, host, sanction archetypes.

soccer_special_and_host#host_result_seri.description: The host-nation result series sit in competition_winner_and_top_n (KXWCHOSTWIN) and relegation_qualification_advancement (KXWCHOSTKO, KXWCHOSTSTAGE), with the best-host comparison KXWCBESTHOST in competition_head_to_head; this key keeps only host announcements (KXWCHOST, KXCOPAAMERICAHOST, KXCLUBWCHOST), whose 'Source Agencies' are undefined and whose co-host outcomes are non-exclusive.
soccer_special_and_host#host_result_seri.what_would_resolve: Definition of Source Agencies in the host-announcement rules and the receiving records' coverage of host-result series.

soccer_special_and_host#leak_reliability.description: No historical dataset of timestamped transfer reports with source tier and eventual outcome exists publicly, so likelihood ratios per tier cannot be calibrated from free sources.
soccer_special_and_host#leak_reliability.what_would_resolve: Build a labelled archive from news and social media over several windows, or purchase a transfer-news dataset.

soccer_special_and_host#legal_process_ti.description: Timing and outcome of the Premier League versus Manchester City proceedings and similar cases depend on confidential legal steps, giving too few comparable cases for stage-duration estimates.
soccer_special_and_host#legal_process_ti.what_would_resolve: Pool comparable sports-governance cases and report wide intervals; treat as low-information.

soccer_special_and_host#sanction_imposin.description: The KXMANCITYTITLES wording names the English Premier League as the imposing body; whether stripping ordered by the FA, EFL, UEFA, CAS or a court (including on appeal) would settle YES is not stated in the sampled text.
soccer_special_and_host#sanction_imposin.what_would_resolve: Read the full rules_primary/secondary for KXMANCITYTITLES and KXMANCITYPREMTITLE and record which bodies count.

soccer_special_and_host#skills_and_title.description: KXMLSSKILLS and ten other specials (next manager of Juventus/Milan, Man City sanction/ban, generic manager-out, Mbappe/Salah next team, international retirement, leave role, UEFA Israel ban) have no rules text, so outcome sets, windows, interim and loan handling are unverified for them.
soccer_special_and_host#skills_and_title.what_would_resolve: Rules text for the eleven TITLE_ONLY specials, starting with KXMLSSKILLS and KXUEFAISRAELBAN.

team_points_and_margin#gap_coaching_sche.description: A managerial change or tactical regime shift changes a club's expected points per match for the rest of the season at once; no input quantifies the effect, and for contenders it moves both the points threshold and the champion margin.
team_points_and_margin#gap_coaching_sche.what_would_resolve: Event-study of PPG before and after managerial changes in top leagues with matched controls.

team_points_and_margin#serial_correlatio.description: The size of serial correlation in team results beyond rating drift is contested and small; it widens season points totals and the margin tail only if it exceeds zero, and estimates may be indistinguishable from zero.
team_points_and_margin#serial_correlatio.what_would_resolve: Estimate phi across 10 seasons with club random effects and test against zero.

team_points_and_margin#standings_awarded.description: Team Points and Margin read the official standings, but no text says how an abandoned or never-played match (awarded result, voided fixture) or a deduction applied after the last match day but before a stated date is handled.
team_points_and_margin#standings_awarded.what_would_resolve: Kalshi rulebook language on the standings snapshot date for season-points markets.

team_points_and_margin#streak_boundary_i.description: The win-streak series moved to unreg:team_win_streak, where its calendar-boundary and win-definition questions now live; in this key the analogous boundary question is the snapshot date of the official standings for Team Points and Margin (a deduction or awarded result after the last match day).
team_points_and_margin#streak_boundary_i.what_would_resolve: Kalshi rulebook language on the standings snapshot used for season-points and margin markets.

team_points_and_margin#wcgs_title_text_m.description: KXWCGSUNDEFEATED is titled 'World Cup Group Stage Undefeated' but its rules text requires three group wins; which wording governs if they diverge, and how a forfeited or abandoned group game counts, is not stated.
team_points_and_margin#wcgs_title_text_m.what_would_resolve: Kalshi clarification or a settled KXWCGSUNDEFEATED market for a team that drew a group game unbeaten.

total_goals#gap_situational_schedule_mot.description: Late-season dead rubbers, rotation after midweek ties, and stakes alter scoring environment (more open or more cautious) but the catalog attaches no stakes or rotation inputs to totals and the sign of the effect is not established.
total_goals#gap_situational_schedule_mot.what_would_resolve: Backtest totals residuals against stakes leverage and rotation indices in league matches over 5 seasons.

total_goals#ladder_rung_set_unknown.description: Only one strike per event is sampled and it is the highest listed rung (up to 11.5), so the full rung set and the volume per rung are not visible; the earlier tail-first reading came from that selection and the primary role of the tail input should be weighted by actual rung volume.
total_goals#ladder_rung_set_unknown.what_would_resolve: List all strikes and volumes per total series from market data and weight inputs by rung volume.

total_goals#lineup_vintage.description: Point-in-time lineup (T-60 minutes) for historical matches is not archived in free sources, so the attack/defence split cannot be backtested point-in-time except via own capture.
total_goals#lineup_vintage.what_would_resolve: Begin forward capture of lineups and use confirmed lineup after the fact only for model fit, not for evaluation.

total_goals#stakes_effect_sign.description: The sign and size of the effect of stakes (dead rubbers, relegation six-pointers) on total goals is unsettled: cagey in some, open in others.
total_goals#stakes_effect_sign.what_would_resolve: Pooled regression of totals residuals on leverage with league and season effects.

total_goals#tail_rungs_sparse.description: Tail multipliers for 6+ and 7+ goals rest on a handful of events per league (under 100 matches in 10 seasons for most leagues), so the shape beyond five goals is poorly identified.
total_goals#tail_rungs_sparse.what_would_resolve: Pool by league-group and mismatch with hierarchical shrinkage and report intervals; avoid trading rungs above 6.5 without calibration evidence.

total_goals#totals_postponement_clause.description: None of the 155 totals texts read carries a cancellation, postponement or abandonment clause (the sibling GAME texts have a 48-hour or two-week fair-price rule), so settlement of a postponed or abandoned match is not visible for totals; 43 series remain TITLE_ONLY.
total_goals#totals_postponement_clause.what_would_resolve: Kalshi's general soccer rulebook clause applying to totals, or the settlement record of a postponed totals event.

total_goals#xg_coverage_fallback.description: Understat covers six leagues, so xG-based ratings are undefined for EFL, Super Lig, Israeli, Saudi, AFCON/qualifier and most other series among the 198; which ratings fall back to goals-only (ClubElo or own results fit) is not specified.
total_goals#xg_coverage_fallback.what_would_resolve: List per-league availability of xG and fall back explicitly to a goals-only Dixon-Coles fit where absent.

unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#card.description: The archetype label covers cards and fouls, but all ten live series are corner counts; no card or foul contract exists in the ledger, so card/foul inputs (referee, fouls_cards) are unverified against any real settlement.
unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#card.what_would_resolve: Check for listed card or foul series; if none, retire the cards component of this archetype.

unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#corn.description: Only the World Cup corner texts carry a postponement clause (two weeks); the EPL, La Liga, UCL and Super Cup corner texts carry none, and no text covers a match abandoned after some corners were taken.
unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#corn.what_would_resolve: Kalshi rulebook clause for postponed or abandoned corner markets.

unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#corn.description: The data provider that supplies the corner count (taken versus awarded, VAR-cancelled corners) is not stated in any sampled text, and provider choice decides the definition and potential disagreements.
unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#corn.what_would_resolve: Read the full rules and source-agency language for the corner series and record the provider.

unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#corn.description: Free sources for blocked-shot and cross counts (needed for the causal corner input) were not verified after reported changes to FBref's Opta feed; football-data.co.uk provides corners and shots but not shot outcomes.
unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#corn.what_would_resolve: Verify one provider for blocked shots and crosses across the leagues with live corner markets.

unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#line.description: Whether starting wingers, full-backs, crossers and the keeper change team corner counts beyond team-level rates has not been tested; role_personnel is covered by lineup availability but the effect size is unknown.
unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#line.what_would_resolve: Regress team corners on starting wide-player and keeper indicators controlling for team rates.

unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#take.description: Only the EPL and La Liga corner texts include the 'actually taken' clause; the UCL, World Cup and UEFA Super Cup texts do not, so whether awarded-but-not-taken corners count there is unknown.
unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#take.what_would_resolve: Fetch the full rules for each corner series and note differences.

unreg:knockout_method_of_victory#u1.description: The sampled rules end mid-sentence on the fair-price rule and name no source of truth; how an abandoned-then-resumed final or a replay within two weeks settles is not visible.
unreg:knockout_method_of_victory#u1.what_would_resolve: Full untruncated rules text for each series plus Kalshi's named data provider.

unreg:knockout_method_of_victory#u2.description: soc.rest_travel and soc.congestion_load are now carried, but whether rest and end-of-season load change extra-time scoring and the ET-vs-penalties split specifically (90-120 window) is not measured by any input.
unreg:knockout_method_of_victory#u2.what_would_resolve: Estimate ET goal share against days of rest and minutes load of the starting XI in historical ET matches.

unreg:knockout_method_of_victory#u3.description: KXWCMOF/KXWCMOV use 'advances' wording; if the series is also listed for World Cup round-of-32 to semi-final ties, the same three-phase model applies but match contexts (rest, rotation) differ and were not sampled.
unreg:knockout_method_of_victory#u3.what_would_resolve: List of all events in the World Cup MOF/MOV series with their rules text.

unreg:knockout_method_of_victory#u4.description: Sports Reference announced on 2026-01-20 that FBref's Opta advanced stats (xG, shot-creating actions) were removed; the record previously named FBref as the xG source. Records now list Understat (big-5 only), FotMob, StatsBomb open data and paid feeds, but whether any of them gives national-team or cup xG with usable history, and under what terms, is not verified. Verified 2026-11-08 against the Sports Reference blog (2026-01-20): the advanced data were removed effective immediately and only historic basic data were kept, so FBref offers no historical xG either; replacement depth/licence is still unverified.
unreg:knockout_method_of_victory#u4.what_would_resolve: Pull a sample of xG fields for the needed competitions/seasons from each replacement source, confirm historical depth and licence terms, or fall back to Elo-only ratings (clubelo.com/eloratings.net).

unreg:match_combo_parlay#u1.description: The sampled prepack has no rules_secondary: treatment of an own goal as the first goal, of the named player not playing, of postponement and the settlement source are all unstated.
unreg:match_combo_parlay#u1.what_would_resolve: Kalshi's full prepack rules or a settled example where the first goal was an own goal or the player did not play.

unreg:match_combo_parlay#u2.description: soc.player_minutes_expectation now carries the planned withdrawal minute, but its catalog definition is season-minutes oriented; the tournament/veteran conditioning (substitution-minute distribution by age and days since previous match) is not yet estimated.
unreg:match_combo_parlay#u2.what_would_resolve: Fit substitution-minute distributions for veterans in tournaments by age and days since previous match.

unreg:match_combo_parlay#u3.description: Only one leg pair was sampled; prepacks with other legs (totals, BTTS, cards) would need different dependence structures and possibly further inputs.
unreg:match_combo_parlay#u3.what_would_resolve: Sample of all KXWCPREPACK events and their leg compositions.

unreg:match_combo_parlay#u4.description: Sports Reference announced on 2026-01-20 that FBref's Opta advanced stats (xG, shot-creating actions) were removed; the record previously named FBref as the xG source. Records now list Understat (big-5 only), FotMob, StatsBomb open data and paid feeds, but whether any of them gives national-team or cup xG with usable history, and under what terms, is not verified. Verified 2026-11-08 against the Sports Reference blog (2026-01-20): the advanced data were removed effective immediately and only historic basic data were kept, so FBref offers no historical xG either; replacement depth/licence is still unverified.
unreg:match_combo_parlay#u4.what_would_resolve: Pull a sample of xG fields for the needed competitions/seasons from each replacement source, confirm historical depth and licence terms, or fall back to Elo-only ratings (clubelo.com/eloratings.net).

unreg:player_appearance_selection#u1.description: KXBALOGUNPLAY and KXTRINITYRODMANNWSL do not define 'plays' (minimum minutes, friendlies, unofficial matches) and no series names its source of truth.
unreg:player_appearance_selection#u1.what_would_resolve: Full rules text or Kalshi clarification on minimum minutes and friendly matches.

unreg:player_appearance_selection#u2.description: Contract negotiation stage and registration intent for out-of-contract players are known only from reporter news of varying reliability; no structured feed exists.
unreg:player_appearance_selection#u2.what_would_resolve: Own-capture log of negotiation reports with source tiers, back-tested against outcomes.

unreg:player_appearance_selection#u3.description: Whether two specific midfielders are complements or substitutes depends on the coach's plan; a manager change inside the window can flip the pair relationship.
unreg:player_appearance_selection#u3.what_would_resolve: Pair overlap rates split by coach tenure and formation.

unreg:player_appearance_selection#u4.description: Injury history sources named (Transfermarkt, Premier Injuries for the EPL) do not cover NWSL or national-team players well; the Rodman and Balogun contracts therefore rely on own capture of club/federation statements, and no structured NWSL injury history was verified.
unreg:player_appearance_selection#u4.what_would_resolve: Check whether NWSL or U.S. Soccer publish dated injury reports with history, otherwise run an own-capture log from team statements.

unreg:player_appearance_selection#u5.description: Basic FBref minutes and lineups probably survive the 2026-01-20 removal of Opta advanced stats, but that was not checked; Transfermarkt match sheets are listed first for substitution minutes in soc.pair_onpitch_overlap_model.
unreg:player_appearance_selection#u5.what_would_resolve: Fetch a recent FBref match report and a Transfermarkt match sheet and confirm substitution minutes are present for the clubs in scope.

unreg:player_appearance_selection#u6.description: KXPLAYWC states only that a player named in the final squad resolves Yes even without appearances; unlike KXWCSQUAD it does not say whether a replacement added after the initial announcement counts or whether a withdrawn player stays Yes.
unreg:player_appearance_selection#u6.what_would_resolve: Full KXPLAYWC rules text for several players or a Kalshi clarification on late additions and withdrawals.

unreg:player_goal_assist_props#assist_de.description: The data provider and assist attribution rules (deflections, second assists, rebounds) are not stated in the sampled text and free sources use different definitions, so training labels may not match settlement.
unreg:player_goal_assist_props#assist_de.what_would_resolve: Identify the settlement data feed and compare its assist labels with free provider labels on 100+ matches.

unreg:player_goal_assist_props#combo_and.description: KXINTLFRIENDLYFGW needs P(player scores first non-own goal AND team wins incl. shootout), a joint event not defined by any input here; 3+ assist and 5+ goal rungs in friendlies are deep tails; and many named players have tiny samples (academy or newly promoted-squad players) with no defined prior beyond position-mean shrinkage.
unreg:player_goal_assist_props#combo_and.what_would_resolve: Define a joint first-scorer-and-result simulation input and a prior for youth and newly promoted-squad players, then test on friendlies and cup matches.

unreg:player_goal_assist_props#fair_pric.description: Series differ between 'fair market price before game start' and 'last fair market price before game start' for DNP settlement, and how that price is computed is not defined in the sampled rules.
unreg:player_goal_assist_props#fair_pric.what_would_resolve: Obtain Kalshi's rule definition of fair price and observe settlement values on past DNP cases.

unreg:player_goal_assist_props#first_goa.description: KXWCFIRSTGOAL, KXWCTEAMFIRSTGOAL and KXWCTEAM1STGOAL state that an own-goal opener passes to the next non-own goal; the EPL and club first-goal texts are cut before the equivalent clause, so whether every first-goalscorer series uses that rule is still not verified.
unreg:player_goal_assist_props#first_goa.what_would_resolve: The untruncated rules_secondary of KXEPLFIRSTGOAL and one other club first-goal series.

unreg:player_goal_assist_props#gap_situa.description: Dead-rubber, congestion and cup-priority effects on whether a star plays 90 minutes or is substituted early depend on stakes, but no pregame stakes input is attached to this archetype and the effect on a player's minutes is only partly in rotation_index.
unreg:player_goal_assist_props#gap_situa.what_would_resolve: Regress starter probability and minutes on stakes leverage and next-fixture importance over 3 seasons of lineups.

unreg:player_goal_assist_props#inactive_.description: The refund rule applies to a player who is active but never enters; what happens to a player who is injured, rested or not in the matchday squad is not stated in the sampled text and decides how much availability probability must enter the price.
unreg:player_goal_assist_props#inactive_.what_would_resolve: Read the full rules_secondary (not truncated) for goal, assist and first-goal series and observe settlement of non-squad players.

unreg:player_goal_assist_props#rules_sec.description: The sampled rules_secondary text is cut at about 400 to 600 characters (the first-goalscorer text ends mid-sentence), so the own-goal, no-goal and extra-time clauses beyond the cut cannot be verified; the family is only partially verified.
unreg:player_goal_assist_props#rules_sec.what_would_resolve: Obtain the untruncated rules_secondary for one goal, one assist and one first-goal series.

unreg:player_shots_saves_props#early_sub.description: How predictable an early substitution of a striker is before kickoff (from stakes, fitness and score state) is unknown, yet it drives the shot-count distribution for the player.
unreg:player_shots_saves_props#early_sub.what_would_resolve: Model substitution minute hazard from 3 seasons of substitution logs with pregame covariates and test out-of-sample.

unreg:player_shots_saves_props#gap_settl.description: No contract text exists for shots or saves series in the ledger, so the counting definition (blocked shots, penalties, extra time) and the DNP rule cannot be verified; only a mapping flag input can be proposed.
unreg:player_shots_saves_props#gap_settl.what_would_resolve: Obtain rules text once a series is listed and fix the provider's event definitions.

unreg:player_shots_saves_props#hypotheti.description: No shots or saves series appears in the ledger and no rules text exists, so every verdict, numeric claim (team shots mean 12, SOT 33%, 30% SOT to goals, saves mean 3 sd 1.7, 20-40% trailer uplift) and the dataset list in this record is a domain assumption; the archetype is a template, not evidence of a listed contract.
unreg:player_shots_saves_props#hypotheti.what_would_resolve: Check whether any shot or save series is ever listed and, if so, re-review against its rules text.

unreg:player_shots_saves_props#keeper_sa.description: No verified free source provides goalkeeper saves, SOT faced and PSxG by match: Understat has team shots without saves, football-data.co.uk is team-only, FBref is unverified and StatsBomb is paid; coverage for non-top-6 leagues is unaddressed.
unreg:player_shots_saves_props#keeper_sa.what_would_resolve: Pull one keeper-match sample from FBref and from a paid provider and compare fields and league coverage.

unreg:player_shots_saves_props#no_live_s.description: No live Kalshi series maps to this archetype in the ledger; the definitions of shots, shots on target, saves, penalties, extra time and DNP are unknown and nothing can be verified against rules text.
unreg:player_shots_saves_props#no_live_s.what_would_resolve: Check for newly listed shot/save series and read their rules; otherwise treat the archetype as hypothetical.

unreg:player_shots_saves_props#saves_pro.description: Provider definitions of saves (include blocked? penalty saves? deflections?) and the free-source availability of keeper SOT faced and PSxG after the reported FBref data change were not verified.
unreg:player_shots_saves_props#saves_pro.what_would_resolve: Verify one provider's keeper save definition and compare with team SOT minus goals on 100 matches.

unreg:player_shots_saves_props#shot_defi.description: The proposed soc.shot_event_definition_mapping needs two providers' counts (for example Opta and a free source) for 200+ matches; no free source pair provides this, and which provider settles the contract is unknown because no series exists.
unreg:player_shots_saves_props#shot_defi.what_would_resolve: Identify the settling provider from a listed series and obtain a paid sample from it.

unreg:player_squad_selection_and_lineup#.description: KXWCSQUAD rules text is truncated after 'Provisional, preliminary,' and the CRON/MESSI series do not say whether a late replacement added before the first match counts.
unreg:player_squad_selection_and_lineup#.what_would_resolve: Full untruncated rules for all final-squad series.

unreg:player_squad_selection_and_lineup#.description: Historical leak accuracy by source tier is not available as a dataset; tier weights would be estimated from a small own-captured sample.
unreg:player_squad_selection_and_lineup#.what_would_resolve: Back-test own-captured reports from the 2022 and 2026 tournaments against official lists.

unreg:player_squad_selection_and_lineup#.description: Positional quotas are de facto, not regulated; coaches vary in how many players per position they take, so the slot model needs per-coach estimates from few past squads.
unreg:player_squad_selection_and_lineup#.what_would_resolve: Per-coach positional distributions from all squads they have named at club-level tournaments and qualifiers.

unreg:player_squad_selection_and_lineup#.description: FIFA tournament rules reportedly allow some replacements after a team's first match (notably injured goalkeepers); KXWCSQUAD only says additions before the team's first match resolve YES, and the CRON/MESSI series are silent, so a later addition is ambiguous. The exact regulation text was not verified.
unreg:player_squad_selection_and_lineup#.what_would_resolve: FIFA World Cup 2026 regulations on squad replacement timing plus Kalshi clarification on later additions.

unreg:player_squad_selection_and_lineup#.description: Provisional-list data for soc.national_team_call_up_history is likely unavailable for most federations because FIFA does not publish provisional lists; the field is now optional but its coverage by federation was not checked.
unreg:player_squad_selection_and_lineup#.what_would_resolve: Survey which federations published provisional lists before 2022 and 2026 and make the flag null-safe.

unreg:team_win_streak#u1.description: Rules do not state whether a penalty-shootout win counts as a win, whether friendlies count, or how a run straddling 31 Dec 2025 is treated; the ticker suffix '27' conflicts with the stated year 2026. Also unresolved: whether the event window is calendar 2026 (rules text) or 2027 (ticker suffix), which changes the number of remaining fixtures from roughly 8-12 to 35-50.
unreg:team_win_streak#u1.what_would_resolve: Kalshi clarification or a settled example with a shootout or straddling run.

unreg:team_win_streak#u2.description: Whether finishing luck is serially correlated enough to cluster wins (beyond strength drift) is untested; it would change how much of the streak uplift is skill.
unreg:team_win_streak#u2.what_would_resolve: Estimate autocorrelation of (goals - xG) residuals across consecutive matches for Premier League clubs.

unreg:team_win_streak#u3.description: Only the 5+ strike was sampled; if other strikes exist they must be priced jointly so the probability ladder is monotone.
unreg:team_win_streak#u3.what_would_resolve: List all markets in the KXWINSTREAKMANU series.

unreg:team_win_streak#u4.description: Sports Reference announced on 2026-01-20 that FBref's Opta advanced stats (xG, shot-creating actions) were removed; the record previously named FBref as the xG source. Records now list Understat (big-5 only), FotMob, StatsBomb open data and paid feeds, but whether any of them gives national-team or cup xG with usable history, and under what terms, is not verified. Verified 2026-11-08 against the Sports Reference blog (2026-01-20): the advanced data were removed effective immediately and only historic basic data were kept, so FBref offers no historical xG either; replacement depth/licence is still unverified.
unreg:team_win_streak#u4.what_would_resolve: Pull a sample of xG fields for the needed competitions/seasons from each replacement source, confirm historical depth and licence terms, or fall back to Elo-only ratings (clubelo.com/eloratings.net). Elo from clubelo.com remains a free fallback, so the input list is not blocked.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#c.description: KXWCCLUBGOALS attributes goals to the club a player is 'currently under contract with'; the date, loanees (parent or loan club) and free agents are not addressed, which can move the maximum club pool.
unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#c.what_would_resolve: Kalshi clarification of the attribution date and loan treatment.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#c.description: The size of the shared tournament effect on goals is estimated from few World Cups, so its variance is poorly pinned and the Total Goals tail rungs are sensitive to it.
unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#c.what_would_resolve: A hierarchical fit over many international tournaments to bound the tournament-level variance and its prior.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#f.description: KXWCFASTESTGOAL uses 'the official match minute as reported by FIFA'; whether a goal at 7:30 is the 8th minute (ceiling convention) or the 7th is not stated and moves the 8th-minute rung.
unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#f.what_would_resolve: Compare FIFA match-report minute stamps with timed footage for known early goals.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#g.description: Only the KXWCGAMEGOALS-26KO event (knockout, incl. ET) has rules in the pack; the independent reviewer reports a 26GS group-stage event '(including regulation and stoppage time)' that is not in the sampled rules, so the group-stage maximum is modelled conditionally.
unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#g.what_would_resolve: Archive the KXWCGAMEGOALS-26GS rules_primary and confirm its scope and strikes.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#p.description: soc.tournament_player_scoring_pool and soc.player_xg relied on FBref npxG; Sports Reference removed all Opta advanced data from FBref on 2026-01-20 (current and historical). World Cup squads draw players from dozens of leagues, and Understat covers only the big-5, so a free source of npxG for every squad player is not established.
unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#p.what_would_resolve: Confirm FotMob/other coverage of npxG for all 48 squads' club leagues with two seasons of history, or budget a paid Opta/StatsBomb feed.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#r.description: Type-specific counts of direct free-kick, olimpico and goalkeeper goals are reliably tagged only in event data (StatsBomb open data for a few tournaments, paid Opta otherwise); Wikipedia goal lists do not consistently mark goal type.
unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#r.what_would_resolve: Confirm StatsBomb open-data coverage per tournament and hand-audit goal types for older World Cups.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#s.description: All sampled markets are status finalized, so these series are historical for the 2026 tournament; settled values are not in the pack, and future use depends on Kalshi relisting similar series for later tournaments.
unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#s.what_would_resolve: Pull m.settlement_truth for each event and check Kalshi for relisted tournament-aggregate series.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#s.description: KXWCLONGESTPEN counts rounds when both teams have each taken a kick; a shootout decided after the first team's kick in a round leaves a partial round whose counting is not specified, shifting a rung by one in rare cases.
unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#s.what_would_resolve: Rule clarification or a settled example of a shootout ending mid-round.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#u.description: KXWCKOPENALTIES is sampled only for the Quarterfinals ('exactly 4'); R32 and R16 events and any 'N+' constructions reported by the reviewer are not in the pack, so their strike construction is assumed to mirror the QF text.
unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#u.what_would_resolve: Archive one market of every KXWCKOPENALTIES event (R32, R16, QF) and record strike_type per event.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#w.description: KXWCWINNERTRAIL says the champion must never trail 'at any point'; it does not state whether falling behind during a penalty shootout counts as trailing. The model excludes shootouts, which matters when the champion wins a shootout after being behind on kicks.
unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#w.what_would_resolve: Kalshi clarification or the settled outcome for a champion that trailed only in a shootout.

unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#eve.description: All sampled markets are finalized, so the 2026 World Cup and Champions League pairings are known and the series are historical; settled values are not in the pack.
unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#eve.what_would_resolve: Pull m.settlement_truth per event and check for relisted pairing series in later competitions.

unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#loc.description: KXWCLOCATION does not define 'played' for a match abandoned after kickoff or relocated within the same country/state, nor the settlement source; edge cases decide NO only in the rare relocation regime.
unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#loc.what_would_resolve: Full rules_secondary for KXWCLOCATION events and a Kalshi clarification of 'played'.

unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#loc.description: The reviewer reports Kalshi lists FIFA, ESPN, Fox Sports and the New York Times as location sources; the pack's sampled text names no source, so the source of truth is unverified.
unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#loc.what_would_resolve: Archive the full KXWCLOCATION market page including the settlement-source field.

unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#mat.description: KXWCMATCHUP-26SEMI2 text says 'the matchup in the Semifinal' while the ticker names a second semifinal slot; whether a pair meeting in the other semifinal settles Yes is not stated, which changes the summed rounds.
unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#mat.what_would_resolve: Read the full rules for both SEMI1 and SEMI2 events or a Kalshi clarification.

unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#thi.description: The best-third allocation table for the 48-team format is recalled, not transcribed from the published annex; a wrong cell changes which pairs can meet in the R32 and R16.
unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#thi.what_would_resolve: Transcribe the annex from the FIFA regulations and test all 495 combinations for legal brackets.

unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#ucl.description: The KXTEAMSINUCL secondary text is cut off at 'Mathematical possib', so the treatment of mathematically clinched qualification and any void rule is not visible.
unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#ucl.what_would_resolve: Retrieve the complete rules_secondary for KXTEAMSINUCL from the historical markets endpoint.

unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#wc2.description: Group tie-break order (head-to-head before overall goal difference) and best-third criteria (conduct score, FIFA ranking) come from secondary reporting, not the regulations text.
unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#wc2.what_would_resolve: Transcribe Article 13 of the FIFA World Cup 2026 regulations and re-run the threshold test.
